force_convention: top boundary carries a uniform compressive traction of magnitude q_L over width a (quarter Mandel, a=1) or 2a (full domain, a=1); expected top resultant is -a*q_L (quarter) or -2*a*q_L (full).
reference_note: The isotropic comparison run uses isotropic_stiffness(28,16.8) with phi_s0=0.6 and K=7, not the reference-modulus problem of the quarter-domain decks (phi_s0=0.9, K=1, G=0.75). A Mandel-normalized discrepancy would compare different problems, so no reference-normalized field is emitted; only the run diagnostics (mass balance, force balance, platen equality, peak pressure) are reported.
